```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Tavern frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Start Tavern server
        working-directory: tavern
        run: |
          cargo run --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml &
          echo "SERVER_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Wait for Tavern server to be ready
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health; then
              echo "Server is up"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Retrieve server public key
        run: |
          PUBLIC_KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/public-key)
          echo "PUBLIC_KEY=$PUBLIC_KEY" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        working-directory: imixv2
        run: cargo build --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        working-directory: imixv2
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 --key "$PUBLIC_KEY" &
          echo "AGENT_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        working-directory: tests/e2e
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        working-directory: tests/e2e
        run: npx playwright test

      - name: Teardown
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]; then
            kill "$SERVER_PID" || true
          fi
          if [ -n "$AGENT_PID" ]; then
            kill "$AGENT_PID" || true
          fi
```
